== Editing ==
This shared table is the '''Errata''' section on the English [[Wedge Antilles]] and [[Wedge Antilles (Errata)]] articles. Use '''Edit errata''' on a member page. Columns are Original · Decipher Errata. Do not transclude onto Revised, Japanese, foil, or (V). {{tl|Errata hl}} only the words or values that changed; an em dash if that field is unchanged from the previous filled cell. See [[SWCCG Wiki:Style guide#Errata comparison table]].
